slides.body: In the International Sex Survey (Bőthe et al., 2024), 21–37% of people with problematic p*rn use wanted treatment but didn't get it — cost was one of the reasons.

slides.title: Free help [[1–3]]
items: A trusted friend who checks in every week.

A daily journal — pen and paper cost almost nothing.

carousels.name: 6 signs your reason for quitting p*rn won't last

slides.title: 6 signs your reason for quitting p*rn [[won't last past a bad week.]]
Signs [[1–3]]
items: It's someone else's reason, not yours.
It's only fear — of getting caught, of shame.
It's a trend you joined for the month.

slides.title: Signs [[4–6]]
items: You can't say it in one sentence.
It's all about stopping p*rn, nothing about what you want instead.
You forget it by 11 PM.

slides.title: Fear fades. [[Wants]] stay.
slides.body: Many people say fear got them started, but wanting something better kept them off p*rn. Build a reason you'd still care about on your worst night.

slides.title: Build a [[better reason]]
items: Finish this: "Without p*rn, I want to…"
Make it about a person or a goal you care about.
Write it where you'll see it at night.
Update it every month.

carousels.name: 4 mistakes that kill p*rn-free streaks (10 days of NNN left)

slides.title: 4 mistakes that kill p*rn-free streaks. [[You've got 10 days to avoid them.]]
slides.sub: Day 20 is where people get lazy.

slides.title: You stop [[guarding]]
slides.body: Blocker paused "for work". Phone back in bed. P*rn didn't get stronger. You opened the door.

slides.title: You start [[flirting]] with it
slides.body: Suggestive posts. "Just checking" an old account. That's not curiosity. That's a p*rn relapse warming up.

slides.title: Mistakes [[3–4]]
items: You skip the boring stuff — sleep, training, check-ins.
You hide a slip instead of saying it out loud.

slides.title: Lock it [[in]]
items: Turn the blocker back on — today, not later.
Unfollow the "just checking" accounts.
Do the boring basics for 10 more days.
If you slip, say it within 24 hours.

items: "They're lying." Plenty of men quit p*rn and stay quit.
